review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner; self-review, not independent approval
review.decision: Correct independently verified F1 with an owner-held successful-send deadline
review.notes: Full independent H report SHA c6d475d8c540ac396e88459a3044ce322aedaa5390a7239c517463d94d5f02ee read and accepted. MessageReceipt local expiry resets on actual legacy compact HQ Console navigation. Preserve successful ingress deadline on the existing parent-owned PendingChatEcho per stable send identity; first successful nonqueued ack stamps once, reused attempts keep it, queued/sending do not start or expire it, and new IDs have independent lifetimes. A missing successful deadline must not invent a fresh mount-based lifetime. Child remount uses only remaining time; transcript confirmation immediately removes the mark. Timestamp is presentation-only and never authorizes send, binding, execution, mutation, polling or resending. Existing attempt/target guards and bounded echo-attempt maps stay intact. Record actual HQ parent/tab/Composer production path under controlled clocks, not only a conditional component stand-in. Existing CAR-003 fixture expectations are preserved while supplying the now-owner-held deadline; legacy matching guards remain. No native UI/device/session input. This design is committed before changed test implementation.

cases.description: Successful ingress lifetime survives actual HQ console unmount and stays scoped to one send on phone/tablet shared readers
cases.setup: Render real HQConsoleView with workspaceMode=false and real ChatView/MessageReceipt; isolated API, controlled clock and actual tabs/Composer. Also inspect HQ and Detail guarded ack owners and standalone receipt fixtures. Hold transcript confirmation pending, return both before and after original deadline; independently test new ID, repeated same-ID stamp, queued/sending, source confirmation and target reset.
cases.action: First run the actual navigation regression against H and retain meaningful assertion failure, then run the same assertions after minimal owner-deadline wiring. Exercise callback/clock/identity boundaries with existing deferred frontend fixtures.
cases.expected: Remount before deadline gets only remaining lifetime; after deadline never revives success without a new send; same-ID acknowledgement cannot renew it. New ID gets independent deadline and old timer cannot hide it. Queued/sending persist; confirmed transcript clears mark immediately. Pending message/attachment remains and original send ID, body, occurrence matching, refusal/late-result guards and send call counts stay intact. HQ/Detail both stamp in guarded successful ack branches. Documentation uses actual Light/Dark labels.
